explication: yt-dlp GUI is a Tauri desktop client for fetching media, configuring downloads, managing tasks, and using yt-dlp-powered toolbox utilities. The main workflow starts with a URL in the home screen, fetches video metadata and formats, lets the user configure a download, then tracks and controls the resulting task. The graph preserves the documented toolbox, settings, and browser-extension branches. Some backend command wiring is not shown in the excerpts, so those relationships are omitted rather than inferred.
